2607.10784.title: LSTrans: Efficient Knowledge Transfer for Lightweight and Automated ECG Classification
2607.10784.paper_summary: Deploying deep learning models for automated electrocardiogram classification on resource-constrained wearable devices remains challenging due to high computational costs. To address this, we propose LSTrans, a lightweight hybrid model designed for efficient and sensitive ECG analysis. LSTrans introduces a specialized 1D convolutional backbone with an interleaved layer architecture to capture both macroscopic rhythmic trends and microscopic morphological variations. This backbone is cascaded with a Transformer encoder to model long-range temporal dependencies, incorporating Low-Rank Adaptation across critical layers to compress the model and reduce the trainable parameter space. We further employ homogeneous and heterogeneous knowledge distillation to transfer diagnostic expertise from high-capacity teacher models to the student. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that LSTrans achieves a competitive balance between diagnostic sensitivity and resource efficiency, substantially reducing peak memory footprints and training latency during downstream adaptation. The source code is available for review at https://github.com/zyee00128/LSTrans4BIBM.
2607.10784.paper_summary_zh: 部署深度學習模型以在資源受限的可穿戴設備上自動分類心電圖仍然面臨挑戰，因為計算成本高。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了LSTrans，一種設計用於高效且敏感的ECG分析的輕量級混合模型。LSTrans引入了一種專門的1D卷積骨幹，具有交錯層架構，以捕捉宏觀的節律趨勢和微觀的形態變化。這個骨幹與Transformer編碼器串聯，以建模長距離的時間依賴性，並在關鍵層中引入低秩適應，以壓縮模型並減少可訓練參數空間。我們進一步採用同質和異質知識蒸餾，將診斷專業知識從高容量教師模型轉移到學生模型。對多個基準數據集的實驗結果表明，LSTrans在診斷靈敏度和資源效率之間達成了競爭平衡，顯著減少了峰值內存佔用和下游適應過程中的訓練延遲。源代碼可在https://github.com/zyee00128/LSTrans4BIBM進行查看。
